name: @hl-bos/bti-venuewise
description: Venuewise startup-analysis pipeline — runs Venuewise through the BTI reasoning contract adapted to a startup value chain (Problem → … → Margin). Reuses @hl-bos/bti-cycle's confidence state machine, evidence model and four permitted outputs; adds the startup value chain, the real (source-labeled) Venuewise evidence, a Reasoning Ledger, a Measurement Contract, and a decision-ready Business Transformation Report. Deterministic and DB-agnostic; invents no data; no UI, APIs, persistence, execution or migrations.
